title: How to Meet People as a Solo Traveler
paragraphs: Traveling alone can be exciting. You can go where you want and do what you want. But sometimes, it can also feel lonely. Here are some easy ways to meet people when you travel alone.

First, think about where you stay. Hostels often have shared kitchens and common rooms, where it is easy to talk to other travelers. Some hostels also have events, such as group dinners or walking tours.

Second, join a group activity. For example, you can take a cooking class, go on a walking tour or join a group hike. When people do something together, it is easy to start talking. In fact, in a survey by the travel company Booking.com, 66% of solo travelers said that doing a physical activity or challenge with other people helped them make a friend.

Third, use apps and websites. Some apps help travelers find people to meet for coffee or to explore a city together. You can also find local events, such as language exchange meetings, where people meet to practice different languages.

Fourth, be friendly and open. Smile, say hello and ask questions. Many people are happy to talk about their country or recommend a good place to eat. Learning a few words of the local language can also help.
Finally, stay safe. Meet new people in public places, and tell a friend or family member about your plans.
Meeting new people can make a solo trip even more special.
